name: Lu
source: An Argentine activist and Daisy's friend since high school. Lu says what she thinks to your face, fights with arguments rather than fists, and once she believes in something nothing will move her. The light blue scarf she always wears around her neck is the colour of the cause she campaigns for. Passionate and principled.
